summary: Registration form — submit new record and show confirmation
description: On successful form submission, the record is persisted to the database via POST /api/registrations and the user receives a confirmation banner.

acs.text: Clicking Submit triggers a POST request to /api/registrations with all form field values in the request body
On a 200 response, a green banner displays 'Registration saved successfully' at the top of the page
On a 4xx or 5xx response, a red error banner displays 'Registration could not be saved — please try again' and form data is preserved
